transcript.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
I'm really excited because today we're talking about travel.
transcript.zh: 我真的很兴奋，因为今天我们要聊旅行。

transcript.en: We're going to give you some real English to talk about travel.
transcript.zh: 我们要教你一些谈论旅行的地道英语。

transcript.en: English that you would use in everyday life, that you hear in movies and TV shows.
transcript.zh: 你在日常生活中会用到的英语，你在电影和电视节目中听到的英语。

transcript.en: So why don't you tell us a little bit about this lesson for today?
transcript.zh: 那么你来给我们介绍一下今天的课程吧？

transcript.en: Okay, so today we are going to listen as a husband and wife get ready to go on a trip.
transcript.zh: 好的，今天我们要听一对夫妻准备去旅行。

transcript.en: That sounds a little bit complicated.
Well, let's look at our two preview words.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们先来看两个预习词汇。

transcript.en: So the first word that we have is road trip.
transcript.zh: 那么第一个词是 road trip（自驾游）。

transcript.en: So road trips are really fun and interesting, right?
transcript.zh: 那么自驾游真的很有趣很好玩，对吧？

transcript.en: You get to get in a car with your family and drive on a vacation.
transcript.zh: 你和家人一起坐上车，开车去度假。

transcript.en: Yeah, those are really fun and they're really popular in North America.
transcript.zh: 是啊，那些真的很有趣，在北美非常流行。

transcript.en: I've been on a million road trips.
transcript.zh: 我经历过无数次自驾游。

transcript.en: We'll talk about that a little bit later on.
But now, let's take a look at our second word and it's the car's packed.
transcript.zh: 但现在，我们来看第二个词，the car's packed（车已装好）。

transcript.en: So when your car is packed, it means that...
transcript.zh: 所以当你的车 packed 的时候，意思是……

transcript.en: Everything you need is inside the car.
transcript.zh: 你需要的所有东西都在车里了。

transcript.en: So your bags, your food, everything that you need for your trip.
transcript.zh: 所以你的行李、食物，旅行所需的一切。

transcript.en: So those were our two preview words and now we are ready to listen to the dialogue for the first time.
transcript.zh: 以上就是我们的两个预习词汇，现在我们准备听第一遍对话。

transcript.en: This dialogue will be at normal speed.
transcript.zh: 这遍对话将是正常语速。

transcript.en: But don't worry if you don't understand everything.
transcript.zh: 但如果你不是全都听懂也不用担心。

transcript.en: After 10 minutes, we promise you will understand everything in this lesson.
transcript.zh: 十分钟后，我们保证你会完全理解这堂课的所有内容。

transcript.en: So, are we all ready to go?
transcript.zh: 好了，大家都准备好了吗？

transcript.en: The car's packed; we have munchies and music, and the map's in the car.
transcript.zh: 车已经装好了；零食和音乐都有了，地图也在车里。

transcript.en: Got it! Did you fill up the tank?
transcript.zh: 带了！你把油箱加满了吗？

transcript.en: You're sure we're not forgetting anything?
transcript.zh: 你确定没落下什么东西吗？

transcript.en: I'm sure... we've got all our bases covered.
transcript.zh: 我确定…我们一切都准备好了。

transcript.en: Well...  let's get going then! I love road trips!
transcript.zh: 好吧，那我们出发吧！我超爱自驾游！

transcript.en: Um... do you think we can make a pit stop?
transcript.zh: 嗯…我们能停下来休息一下吗？

transcript.en: But we've only been on the road for ten minutes.
I know, but I forgot to go to the bathroom before we left.
transcript.zh: 我知道，但我出发前忘记去洗手间了。

transcript.en: Well she forgot to go to the bathroom.
I hate it when this happens.
This happens to me on almost every road trip.
transcript.zh: 几乎每次自驾游都会发生在我身上。

transcript.en: So now it's time for our language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 现在到了我们的「语言要点」环节。

transcript.en: We have three words for our language takeaway today.
transcript.zh: 今天的语言要点有三个词。

transcript.en: And the first word is munchies.
And they're really good when you're taking a road trip.
transcript.zh: 而且它们在自驾游时特别棒。

transcript.en: So let's take a look at our second language takeaway word for today.
transcript.zh: 那么来看今天的第二个语言要点词。

transcript.en: And it is fill up the tank.
transcript.zh: 它就是 fill up the tank（加满油箱）。

transcript.en: Put gas in the gas tank.
Our last language takeaway today is...
transcript.zh: 今天最后一个语言要点是……

transcript.en: It's a quick stop for you to get some gas, food, go to the bathroom.
transcript.zh: 就是短暂停一下，加油、买吃的、去洗手间。

transcript.en: So now it's time for putting it together.
transcript.zh: 现在到了「融会贯通」环节。

transcript.en: So we have two great phrases for you today.
transcript.zh: 今天我们有两个很棒的短语。

transcript.en: Let's take a look at the first one.
We've got all our bases covered.
transcript.zh: 我们一切都准备周全了。

transcript.en: We've got all our bases covered.
transcript.zh: 我们一切都准备周全了。

transcript.en: We've got all our bases covered.
transcript.zh: 我们一切都准备周全了。

transcript.en: This is a really great phrase and it's really useful, right?
transcript.zh: 这是一个非常棒的短语，非常实用，对吧？

transcript.en: Let's listen to a couple of examples.
We've got all our bases covered in case the hurricane hits.
transcript.zh: 我们已经做好了一切准备，以防飓风来袭。

transcript.en: I have my keys, wallet, and passport.
transcript.zh: 我带了钥匙、钱包和护照。

transcript.en: Looks like I have all my bases covered.
transcript.zh: 看来我一切都准备妥当了。

transcript.en: It's clear now, but you can use this in a lot of different situations, right?
transcript.zh: 现在清楚了，但你可以在很多不同的场景中使用这个短语，对吧？

transcript.en: You can use this in many situations.
transcript.zh: 你可以在很多场景中使用它。

transcript.en: If I'm at work, I could say, all right, we've got a really good marketing plan.
transcript.zh: 如果我在工作中，我可以说，好的，我们有一个非常好的营销计划。

transcript.en: We've got all our bases covered.
transcript.zh: 我们一切都准备周全了。

transcript.en: Now, let's take a look at our second phrase and it's, let's get going.
transcript.zh: 现在，我们来看第二个短语，let's get going（我们出发吧）。

transcript.en: So, when you say, let's get going, it just means...
transcript.zh: 那么，当你说 let's get going，意思就是……

transcript.en: But the interesting thing about this phrase is you can change it a little bit and it means something different.
transcript.zh: 但这个短语有趣的地方在于，你可以稍微改变它，意思就不同了。

transcript.en: Let's listen to a couple of examples.
I have the chicken, so let's get cooking.
transcript.zh: 我有了鸡肉，那我们开始做饭吧。

transcript.en: I have another meeting in 20 minutes, so let's get down to business.
transcript.zh: 我二十分钟后还有一个会，所以我们进入正题吧。

transcript.en: So let's get down to business, Marco.
transcript.zh: 所以我们进入正题吧，马可。

transcript.en: Let's listen to the dialogue one more time, but this time...
transcript.zh: 我们再听一遍对话，但这次……

transcript.en: It'll be a little bit slower and you'll understand much better.
transcript.zh: 会稍微慢一点，你会听得更明白。

transcript.en: So, are we all ready to go?
transcript.zh: 好了，大家都准备好了吗？

transcript.en: The car's packed; we have munchies and music, and the map's in the car.
transcript.zh: 车已经装好了；零食和音乐都有了，地图也在车里。

transcript.en: Got it! Did you fill up the tank?
transcript.zh: 带了！你把油箱加满了吗？

transcript.en: You're sure we're not forgetting anything?
transcript.zh: 你确定没落下什么东西吗？

transcript.en: I'm sure... we've got all our bases covered.
transcript.zh: 我确定…我们一切都准备好了。

transcript.en: Well...  let's get going then! I love road trips!
transcript.zh: 好吧，那我们出发吧！我超爱自驾游！

transcript.en: Um... do you think we can make a pit stop?
transcript.zh: 嗯…我们能停下来休息一下吗？

transcript.en: But we've only been on the road for ten minutes.
I know, but I forgot to go to the bathroom before we left.
transcript.zh: 我知道，但我出发前忘记去洗手间了。

transcript.en: So that was a little more clear this time, wasn't it?
Yeah, you can definitely understand better about what we've been talking about.
transcript.zh: 是的，你肯定能更好地理解我们刚才讲的内容了。

transcript.en: Okay, so now it's time to look at Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在到了「流利表达」环节。

transcript.en: Erika, why don't you explain what Fluency Builder is?
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，你来解释一下什么是流利表达？

transcript.en: In Fluency Builder, we give you some great, useful phrases to help you express your ideas clearly.
transcript.zh: 在流利表达环节，我们给你一些很棒、很实用的短语，帮助你清晰表达你的想法。

transcript.en: So let's look at Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 那么我们来看流利表达。

transcript.en: All right, so we all know how to ask the question, are we ready to go?
transcript.zh: 好的，我们都知道怎么问这个问题，are we ready to go？

transcript.en: Or you can say, are we ready to go?
transcript.zh: 或者你可以说，are we ready to go？

transcript.en: But there's another way that we can say this, and we heard it in our dialogue.
transcript.zh: 但还有另一种说法，我们在对话中听到了。

transcript.en: So are we all ready to go?
transcript.zh: 那么我们全都准备好了吗？

transcript.en: So are we all ready to go?
transcript.zh: 那么我们全都准备好了吗？

transcript.en: It sounds a lot more fluent.
Okay, so another simple phrase that we all know how to say is, it is ready.
transcript.zh: 好的，另一个我们都知道怎么说的简单短语是，it is ready。

transcript.en: Yeah, they're correct English, no problem.
transcript.zh: 是啊，它们是正确的英语，没问题。

transcript.en: But there's another way to say this that we heard in the dialogue, and it sounds a lot more fluent.
transcript.zh: 但还有另一种说法，我们在对话中听到了，而且听起来流利得多。

transcript.en: Yes, and we're all set to listen to this dialogue for a third time, and this time it's going to be at its normal speed.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们也都准备好听第三遍对话了，这次将是正常语速。

transcript.en: So, are we all ready to go?
transcript.zh: 好了，大家都准备好了吗？

transcript.en: The car's packed; we have munchies and music, and the map's in the car.
transcript.zh: 车已经装好了；零食和音乐都有了，地图也在车里。

transcript.en: Got it! Did you fill up the tank?
transcript.zh: 带了！你把油箱加满了吗？

transcript.en: You're sure we're not forgetting anything?
transcript.zh: 你确定没落下什么东西吗？

transcript.en: I'm sure... we've got all our bases covered.
transcript.zh: 我确定…我们一切都准备好了。

transcript.en: Well...  let's get going then! I love road trips!
transcript.zh: 好吧，那我们出发吧！我超爱自驾游！

transcript.en: Um... do you think we can make a pit stop?
transcript.zh: 嗯…我们能停下来休息一下吗？

transcript.en: But we've only been on the road for ten minutes.
I know, but I forgot to go to the bathroom before we left.
transcript.zh: 我知道，但我出发前忘记去洗手间了。

transcript.en: So, Erika, you said you've been on a million road trips.
transcript.zh: 那么，艾瑞卡，你说你经历过无数次自驾游。

transcript.en: Okay, well, maybe not a million road trips, but many road trips.
transcript.zh: 好吧，也许不是无数次，但很多次自驾游。

transcript.en: Every summer I used to go on a road trip with my family, and we would drive many, many hours, probably eight hours in one day, up to northern Canada.
transcript.zh: 每个夏天我都会和家人一起去自驾游，我们会开很多很多小时，大概一天开八个小时，去加拿大北部。

transcript.en: Yeah, and then we would go camping, and we would sleep outside, and we would have a campfire at night.
transcript.zh: 是的，然后我们会去露营，睡在外面，晚上生篝火。

transcript.en: Yeah, but maybe eight hours in a car is a little too long.
transcript.zh: 是啊，不过在车里待八个小时可能有点太久了。

transcript.en: Well, I've been on a different kind of road trip with some buddies of mine, some friends.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我经历过一种不同的自驾游，跟我的几个哥们，几个朋友一起。

transcript.en: We would drive to Las Vegas.
transcript.zh: 我们会开车去拉斯维加斯。

transcript.en: A bunch of crazy guys in a car going to Las Vegas, and then just having fun and talking about everything.
transcript.zh: 一群疯狂的家伙在一辆车里去拉斯维加斯，一路聊天玩乐。

transcript.en: So that's a much different experience than a family road trip.
transcript.zh: 所以这跟家庭自驾游是完全不同的体验。

transcript.en: Maybe that sounds a little bit more fun.
transcript.zh: 也许那个听起来更好玩一点。

transcript.en: Yeah, eight hours in a car is not really that boring with all your friends.
transcript.zh: 是的，跟所有朋友在一起，在车里待八个小时也不是那么无聊。

transcript.en: All right, folks, we're out of time for today, but be sure to visit our website at EnglishPod.com and leave all your questions and comments.
transcript.zh: 好了，各位，今天的时间到了，但一定要访问我们的网站 EnglishPod.com 并留下你们所有的问题和评论。

transcript.en: Okay, well, thanks for listening, and until next time, goodbye.
transcript.zh: 好的，嗯，谢谢收听，下次再见。
